conditions: A simple entry call has been issued and the dynamic-semantics check finds the named entry closed.
limitations: The statement concerns entry queuing. Selection policies, cancellation rules and completion of the corresponding task or protected action are separate.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, correction, or material counterexample.

statement: The Ada 2022 Reference Manual describes queuing a simple entry call if the named entry is closed when the issued call is checked. It remains queued until selected or cancelled.
